entities.name: Saadet Özkan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Saadet Özkan is a Turkish activist against child abuse. She is a primary school teacher who found out that her pupils had been sexually abused by her principal. Despite pressure, she succeeded in getting the crime investigated. She is an International Women of Courage Award recipient.
